Both `used to` statements are closed by normalize_past_assertion, which reads the statement and not a temporal field, so the interval close survives the tool surface's single `when`. worksFor is a declared Person predicate whose fact kind the write path derives as `relationship` (it points at an entity). The two former jobs are co-equal closed history, so no fact_conflict. Authored tool calls: the faithful default quotes every fact accurately and so cannot reproduce a fumbled one.
